556:t_1:167.en:
$$ラルク$$
($$ニコラ$$... Don't tell me...)

556:t_1:168.en:
$$タケル$$
「Are you all right, $$シンジ$$?」

556:t_1:170.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$ニコラ$$ seemed to be in a bad mood. You don't need to worry about it.」

556:t_1:172.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Ignorance can be a terrible sin.」

556:t_1:174.en:
$$カヲル$$
「But I think this is a good opportunity.」

556:t_1:176.en:
$$カヲル$$
「What that man, $$レナード$$, is trying to do... It's very interesting.」

556:t_1:177.en:
$$カヲル$$
「$$シンジ$$... I think the next sortie will have great significance for you, too.」

556:t_1:186.en:
$$レナード$$
「Fifty-three meters in diameter... This is the core of the world's largest 《$$ＴＡＲＯＳ$$》, the largest in history.」

556:t_1:187.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$オムニスフィア転移反応時空通信変容炉$$... In other words, 《$$ＴＡＲＴＡＲＯＳ$$》.」

556:t_1:188.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It will soon begin operating. The device that will repair this world.」

556:t_1:189.en:
$$レナード$$
「But $c is coming... $$テレサ$$ and $$相良宗介$$, too.」

556:t_1:190.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I killed $$テッサ$$ and $$宗介$$ at $$ヤムスク１１$$, didn't I?」

556:t_1:192.en:
$$レナード$$
(That was only one of the possibilities you saw there... But you don't even doubt it...)

556:t_1:193.en:
$$かなめ$$
「The control code adjustments will be complete soon.」

556:t_1:194.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Then $$ＴＡＲＴＡＲＯＳ$$ will be finished. Its very existence is a revolution against fate.」

556:t_1:196.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'll control humanity's fate and guide the world. To a world that satisfies everyone.」

556:t_1:199.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Sometimes I feel someone inside me who isn't me...」

556:t_1:200.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It seems that person fiercely blames me and protests everything I do.」

556:t_1:201.en:
$$レナード$$
「You're a little tired. You've been working nonstop since we returned from $$ヤムスク$$.」

556:t_1:202.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But that will soon be over, too.」

556:t_1:203.en:
$$レナード$$
「Concentrate on your work. If necessary, I'll eliminate anyone who gets in our way.」

556:t_1:205.en:
$$レナード$$
「Objectively speaking, about ninety percent.」

556:t_1:206.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Could it be that you aren't confident?」

556:t_1:207.en:
$$レナード$$
「They're the strongest force on this planet. Even I might lose once if we fought ten times.」

556:t_1:209.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'm always modest. Anyway, that's the situation, so I'd like you to hurry as much as possible.」

556:t_1:210.en:
$$レナード$$
「I want to be prepared, even for a ten percent chance.」

556:t_1:211.en:
$$かなめ$$
「All right. But it won't be long now.」

556:t_1:212.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Soon, a serene, clear, gentle world will come. An infinite sky beyond the underworld... I'm sure you'll see it, too.」

556:t_1:215.en:
$$レナード$$
「I want to see you there... In the new world, too. In whatever form we can.」

556:t_1:216.en:
$$かなめ$$
「All right. Let's have a leisurely cup of tea in some peaceful town on a sunny day.」

556:t_1:217.en:
$$かなめ$$
「That's right. Let's invite $$テッサ$$ for tea, too.」

556:t_1:218.en:
$$かなめ$$
「The three of us will have a lovely chat, with her getting along with you and knowing nothing of war.」

556:t_1:219.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'll see my school friends and Mom, too. Everyone will be well... And this time, I'll be happy.」

556:t_1:223.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's about time I started preparing that thing.」

556:t_1:224.en:
$$レナード$$
「First, we need to use it to crack the dimensional boundary... The very nature of the world.」

556:t_1:225.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Be careful. It's difficult to handle.」

556:t_1:227.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'd welcome that. Though $c will be the ones dealing with it.」

556:t_1:228.en:
$$レナード$$
「Well... I'm counting on you to handle the rest.」

556:t_1:231.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Why couldn't I remember him right away? He was supposed to be someone very important to me...)

556:t_1:232.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Is the guilt of shooting him dead with my own hands making me try to forget him...?)

556:t_1:233.en:
$$かなめ$$
(...Ridiculous. Killing him was something that happened in a temporary reality. He'll be alive and well in the other world.)

556:t_1:234.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I can see him whenever I want. As long as this plan succeeds and I save the world...)

556:t_1:235.en:
$$かなめ$$
(So I must hurry... I will... save the world...)

556:t_2:4.en:
$$かなめ$$
「A higher-dimensional life-form... A god, huh...」

556:t_2:5.en:
$$かなめ$$
(If that power can save the world, I'll become a god, or anything else...)

556:t_2:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
(The three goddesses who govern fate... I am $$クロト$$, $$ラケシス$$, and $$アトロポス$$...)

556:t_2:7.en:
$$かなめ$$
(A world I cannot accept... Events that must be denied... I will take them all upon myself, cherish them, and transform them.)

556:t_2:8.en:
$$かなめ$$
(From now on, forever... Until everyone is satisfied...)

556:t_2:9.en:
$$かなめ$$
(The transformation of the world, now...)

556:t_3:4.en:
$$かなめ$$
(In a strong voice that reaches far away... All the way into the past...)

556:t_3:5.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I'll reweave this twisted world's torn and crumpled fabric into a peaceful world where no one is hurt... With the thread of this voice...)

556:t_3:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I'll start over... Everything, from that day 18 years ago...)

556:t_3:7.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Then, by the time I'm eighteen, I'll live happily with my family, enjoy high school with my classmates, and...)
